body: Thanks. Correction: the four unstaged .Rbuildignore lines (.impeccable, .ruff_cache, PRODUCT.md, cran-comments.md) are not mine; I have not edited .Rbuildignore. My edits on main are untracked only: PRODUCT.md, .impeccable/, docs/plans/mlv-studio-spec.md, plus mote beads mlv-studio*. Studio M0 is now on branch studio-m0 in worktree /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/mlvtoolbox-studio-m0 (from 92d7c93). On that branch only it will add R/studio*.R, studio/, inst/studio/, tests, and touch DESCRIPTION (Suggests: httpuv, jsonlite), NAMESPACE, .Rbuildignore (^studio$) and inst/COPYRIGHTS (bundled JS licences).
